Buffs and stacking

Every buff in the game shows as an icon above the tower. The icon model records whether it stacks and how many times. This table shows which synergies add up.

Data: 57.4 (Mod Helper export, 2026-11-04)

All buff indicators

stackable shows whether a buff with the same name stacks from a second source. maxStackSize 0 = no limit set. globalRange = works across the whole map. Source: the tower whose model carries this icon. Others (heroes and so on) are guessed from the icon name.
